items.q: Why do some profiles have a video?
items.a: Cleaners can add a short video introduction so you can meet the person before booking.

items.q: Can I set up a recurring booking?
items.a: Yes. Choose recurring booking and the job repeats automatically at the interval you pick.
The amount may be held on your card while your booking request is processed. It is charged once the provider accepts the booking, and paid out to the provider after the service has been carried out.

Yes. You can cancel a booking from My bookings. What a cancellation may cost, and whether a refund is possible, depends on how close to the start time you cancel — see the applicable terms in our rules.

items.q: How does the provider get access to my home?
items.a: You arrange access directly with your chosen provider. MyCleaner does not receive keys, does not store keys and does not arrange key handovers. You choose the access solution and are responsible for it.

items.q: What happens if something is damaged?
items.a: Create a support case with photos and a description. MyCleaner is the platform between the customer and the provider. Any damage claim is assessed based on the documentation, the provider's responsibility and the applicable terms.

foundingCleaner.intro: The Founding Cleaner program plans to give the first 500 approved Cleaners who submit their provider application in 2026 a benefit of 0 in provider platform fee for three calendar months. terms.heading: Planned terms
items: The Founding Cleaner program is not yet active. Submitting an application does not automatically grant the benefit and does not reserve a campaign spot.
A maximum of 500 spots may be allocated globally across all markets.

Only completed provider applications submitted in the 2026 calendar year (from 1 January 2026 through 31 December 2026 inclusive) may be considered. The authoritative timestamp is provider_profiles.submitted_at on the server.
Approval may take place after 2026. A spot is only allocated server-side upon final approval and activation.
At most one campaign benefit is granted per verified natural person, even if that person controls multiple businesses. Duplicate profiles do not receive additional benefits.
The planned benefit is 0 in MyCleaner's provider platform fee for three calendar months. The customer's separate platform fee is not affected.
Payment processing costs, tax, VAT, insurance and other third-party costs are not automatically changed by the program.
The period lasts three calendar months via started_at + interval ‘3 months’ and is not measured in 90 days.

The period only starts when the first qualifying job has been completed, paid/captured, customer-confirmed or processed under the existing completion rule, and approved for release under MyCleaner's existing 24-hour hold and dispute control.
A full refund or open dispute before release does not start the period. A refund or chargeback after the start does not reset or extend the period.
MyCleaner notifies applicants directly if they are allocated a spot. No public countdown or remaining-spots counter is published.

Final campaign terms must be accepted when the program is activated. MyCleaner may change or end the planned program for future participants; an already confirmed campaign benefit will not be changed retroactively in violation of applicable law.
